content: {"reasoning":"The CO-50 denial permits a medical-necessity appeal, and a prior correction/resubmission has already failed to resolve the denial involving the payer-invalid diagnosis pairing. Appeal using the available clinical documentation to address medical necessity and the diagnosis issue without inventing unsupported codes. Authorization is not required, peer-to-peer review is unavailable, and the full denied balance cannot properly be shifted to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
